Thanks again for today's checkpoint. Per our call, it looks like two procurement approvals and a SOC-2 evidence pull (QA logs) will push your original go/no-go out by ~2 weeks. To keep the evaluation cadence healthy I drafted a short rebaseline and an associated risk log (attached).

- Evaluation window extended to 2025-08-08 with staggered acceptance gates

I attached: revised_MAP_v2.pdf and a compact risk log.
